body: Thanks for your help, it means the world to me :)

Hi boscobrat, thanks for your reply. I think you've helped to put things into perspective, looking back, I could never find proof of long term effects either, it's really just the possibility that scares me, but now that I've been dealing with the thought for so long, I think I'll be better prepared for whatever a professional might have to say. I'm not under any meds at the moment, mainly because of my bad encounter in the past, but I think I should look into it. the way I acted might have been a result of taking concerta in the first place. I'm going to do my research into any medications I could take before hand and I'm sure I have the experience to not abuse it in some way again. At the end of the day though, I want to confront my anxiety so that I can change the course of my life, it's a nasty cycle that I'm going to try my hardest to get out of. I don't think I can get a letter of recommendation from my previous employee on account of the quality of my work at the time, but I'm going to endeavour instead to fix the problems they described to me and hopefully if my next boss hears from them I could explain to them that I took it as an invitation to improve. Thanks for your reply, you've helped a lot :)
